box.highlights: Ward Melville 35, Longwood 7: Joe Benedetto had nine carries for 84 yards and a touchdown and caught a 74 yard touchdown to lead host Ward Melville in Suffolk I. Hudson Philbrick had three completions for 140 yards and two touchdowns. Joe Karpowicz had a 22-yard touchdown reception and JJ Alcindor had a 44-yard reception. Jesse Spronck had an interception. Kyon Sarwari had 105 rushing yards and a touchdown for Longwood.

Longwood 19, Sachem East 7: Kyon Sarwari rushed for 158 yards and three touchdowns on 23 carries to lead Longwood (1-1) over host Sachem East in Suffolk I. Travis Gibbs blocked a key field goal in the fourth quarter, which was returned 48 yards by Caleb Munoz. Sarwari capped the ensuing drive, which included a 21-yard catch by Craig Harty, with a 3-yard touchdown run to give Longwood a 12-7 lead in the fourth quarter. Sarwari later had a 12-yard touchdown run to secure the victory. Mark Davis had an interceptions and Nyyir Thomas had a fumble recovery as well. Sachem East is 1-1.

Longwood 50, Brentwood 19: Kyon Sarwari rushed for 83 yards on 8 carries and 2 TDs to lead host Longwood (2-1) in Suffolk I. Mark Davis and Makai Jacobs each added a rushing TD. Ryan Greene completed 9 of 11 passes for 142 yards and 2 TDs. Craig Harty had 9 tackles and Gio Johnson had 8. Ed Princivil had a sack, and Marko Tricarico had an interception.

Floyd 21, Longwood 18: Ja'Quan Thomas rushed for 214 yards and 2 TDs on 18 carries to lead host Floyd (4-0) in Suffolk I. Aisays Wallace rushed for 102 yards and a TD on 9 carries, while adding a sack on defense. Aidan Williams racked up 3 tackles for loss and a sack on defense. Ryan Greene threw 2 TD passes and Craig Harty had 12 tackles for Longwood (2-2).

Longwood 36, Riverhead 0: Kyon Sarwari had 159 all-purpose yards and 3 TDs to lead visiting Longwood (3-2) in Suffolk I. Nyyir Thomas had four tackles and 2 sacks and Travis Gibbs, Tyler Lorentzen, Hayri Ozgun, Caleb Munoz, Craig Harty, and Ed Princivil each added sacks. Craig Harty had 5 tackles and a sack, Matt Reany had 4 tackles.

Whitman 15, Longwood 14: Aiden Jorgensen caught an 8-yard touchdown from Dodge Alahverdian on 4th-and-goal with under two minutes remaining go to lead visiting Whitman (4-2) in Suffolk I. Mark Rutledge and Justin Amaya combined on a tackle for loss on 4th-and-1 with 30 seconds left to seal the victory. Micah Brandon and Jarone Park each had an interception. John Mannino kicked field goals of 28, 39 and 27 yards. Craig Harty had six tackles and blocked a field goal for Longwood (3-3).

Sachem North 24, Longwood 14: Luke LaRocca completed 14 of 19 passes for 195 yards and 2 TDs to lead visiting Sachem North (5-2) in Suffolk I. Jake Spera had a rushing TD and Lucas Bouchard and Gavin Nuzzi each had a receiving TD. Micah Laney caught a 49-yard TD pass from Ryan Greene for Longwood (3-4).

Longwood 35, Lindenhurst 21:  Kyon Sarwari had 171 yards on 16 carries and a touchdown and Mark Davis had 111 yards and two touchdowns on just six carries to lead Longwood (4-4) in Suffolk I. The Longwood Offensive Line of Ayari Graham, Jacob Duarte, Tyler Lorentzen, Matt Reany, Ed Princivil, Michael Duarte, and Keyshawn Profitt  helped the Lions run for 341 yards on the ground. Craig Harty had eight tackles and a forced fumble and had a fumble recovery. Ryan Murgatroyd had a 60-yard TD run for Lindenhurst (5-3).

Longwood 22, Whitman 14: Kyon Sarwari rushed for 100 yards on 16 carries and a touchdown in No.4 Longwood's win over No.5 Whitman in the quarterfinals of the Suffolk I playoffs. Ryan Green threw a 51-yard TD pass to Micah Laney. Kaden Reid and Tyler Lorentzen both had nine tackles. Nyyir Thomas had two sacks and Matt Reany had one. Longwood (5-4) will face No.1 Floyd 1 p.m. at Floyd in the semifinals. Whitman finished 5-4.

Floyd 41, Longwood 7
Ja'Quan Thomas had 10 carries for 122 yards and 3 touchdowns as No. 1 Floyd defeated No. 4 Longwood in the Suffolk Division I football semifinals. Floyd advanced to its 21 Suffolk in coach Paul Longo's 31 years as the head coach. Floyd (10-0) will face No. 2 Ward Melville (9-1) in the final at 7:30 p.m. on Friday at Stony Brook University.
Longwood finished 5-5.
